app.name: Better power display
app.summary: Live power flow in watts: grid, solar, battery, home and your devices, drawn like power-flow-card-plus.
app.grid_hint: A power sensor of your grid meter, in W or kW. Positive is power taken from the grid.
app.solar_hint: A power sensor of your solar panels.
app.battery_hint: A power sensor of your battery. Positive is power the battery gives.
app.battery_level_hint: The battery's charge in percent. Shown in the battery's circle.
app.home_hint: Optional. Without it the home's power is worked out from grid, solar and battery.
app.device_hint: Power sensors of single devices. They leave the home. The tile shows as many as it has room for.
app.invert_grid_hint: Turn on when your grid sensor is positive while you feed power into the grid.
app.invert_battery_hint: Turn on when your battery sensor is positive while the battery charges.
app.device_colors_hint: Pick colours in the order of the devices: the first for device 1, and so on. Devices without a pick get a colour of their own.
app.flow_min_hint: Below this power a line is idle and shows no moving dots.
app.kw_from_hint: From this power on, values are shown in kW instead of W.
app.animate_hint: Dots move along the lines in the direction of the power. Turn off if the screen feels slow.
